gbifID.description: Unique GBIF occurrence identifier for each Asota plana record.

datasetKey.description: Unique identifier for the dataset containing the occurrence records.

occurrenceID.description: Unique iNaturalist observation URLs identifying individual Asota plana records.

kingdom.description: The kingdom for all Asota plana records is Animalia.

phylum.description: The phylum for all Asota plana records is Arthropoda.

class.description: Taxonomic class of the recorded Asota plana specimens.

order.description: The taxonomic order of the recorded Asota plana specimens.

family.description: The family is Erebidae for all 996 Asota plana occurrence records.

genus.description: The genus of the Asota plana species.

species.description: The scientific name of the recorded species, consistently identified as Asota plana.

infraspecificEpithet.description: Infraspecific epithet of the Asota plana subspecies.

taxonRank.description: Taxonomic rank of the recorded Asota plana specimens, specifically species or subspecies.

scientificName.description: Scientific name of the species, including subspecies and authorship details.

verbatimScientificName.description: Original scientific name provided in the source data, including subspecies designations.

verbatimScientificNameAuthorship.description: Authorship of the verbatim scientific name is not recorded in this dataset.

countryCode.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country codes for species occurrence records.

locality.description: The locality field is entirely empty, containing no recorded geographic information for any occurrence.

stateProvince.description: Geographic state or province of species occurrence records.

occurrenceStatus.description: The occurrence status of Asota plana, recorded as present.

individualCount.description: The individual count field is entirely empty across all records.

publishingOrgKey.description: Unique identifier for the publishing organization.

decimalLatitude.description: Decimal latitude coordinates in degrees, ranging from -9.23 to 33.11.

decimalLongitude.description: Decimal longitude coordinates in degrees, ranging from 73.24 to 144.10.

coordinateUncertaintyInMeters.description: Coordinate uncertainty radius in meters for species occurrence records.

coordinatePrecision.description: The coordinate precision field is entirely empty, containing no recorded values.

elevation.description: Elevation data is entirely missing from the occurrence records.

elevationAccuracy.description: Elevation accuracy is not recorded for any occurrence records.

depth.description: Depth is not recorded for these occurrence records.

depthAccuracy.description: This column is entirely empty, containing no recorded data.

eventDate.description: Event date and time of species observation, recorded in ISO 8601 format.

day.description: Day of the month, ranging from 1 to 31.

month.description: Integer values from 1 to 12 representing the month of species occurrence.

year.description: Integer values representing the calendar year of species occurrence records.

taxonKey.description: Taxonomic identifier for Asota plana occurrence records.

speciesKey.description: Unique alphanumeric identifier for the Asota plana species.

basisOfRecord.description: The method of species observation recorded for each occurrence record.

institutionCode.description: The institution code identifies the source of the occurrence records.

collectionCode.description: The collection code for the Asota plana occurrence records.

catalogNumber.description: Unique numeric identifier for each Asota plana occurrence record.

recordNumber.description: A placeholder column with no recorded data.

identifiedBy.description: Identifier of the person who identified the Asota plana specimen.

dateIdentified.description: Date and time when the specimen was identified.

license.description: The license field specifies the Creative Commons usage terms for the occurrence records.

rightsHolder.description: Identifier of the copyright holder for the occurrence record data.

recordedBy.description: Names of the individuals who recorded the Asota plana occurrences.

typeStatus.description: This column is entirely empty, containing no recorded data values.

establishmentMeans.description: All records are missing establishment means data.

lastInterpreted.description: Timestamp of the last interpretation for each occurrence record.

mediaType.description: Media type of the occurrence record, primarily still images.

issue.description: Semicolon-separated flags indicating data quality issues such as rounded coordinates or missing taxon IDs.
